## Last Verse
<!--Put a short poem of your choice 8-20 lines,here!-->

I wake up to a brand-new day,  
And wonder where the road will lead.  
The sun begins to light my way,  
As I move forward at my speed.  

There may be moments filled with doubt,  
And days when everything feels wrong.  
But I will find a way throughout,  
And keep on moving, staying strong.  

The world is wide, the sky is bright,  
There are so many things to see.  
I’ll chase my dreams with all my might,  
And become who I want to be.  

I’ll learn from every single fall,  
And use my mistakes to grow.  
I may not have the answers all,  
But there is still so much to know.
